body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its high-end 19-inch wide monitor ‘L197WH-PF’ during KES 2007, which features 5000:1 contrast ratio. As a Windows Vista Premium certified product, it offers 2ms response speed, 1,440x900 resolution and 300cd/m² brightness and 160-degree viewing angle.
